title: 2A Abbotstown Avenue, Finglas, Dublin 11
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this fantastic, three-bedroom mid-terrace home to the market, ideally located on the ever-popular Abbotstown Avenue in Finglas, Dublin 11.

Built in 2022, this superb property offers energy-efficient and modern living in a highly convenient and family-friendly location. Abbotstown Avenue is ideally situated close to Finglas Village, with an excellent selection of local amenities and transport links nearby. These include Finglas Village, Erin's Isle GAA, a range of excellent primary and secondary schools, parks, churches and DCU, all within easy reach. Charlestown Shopping Centre, Clearwater Shopping Centre and IKEA are also conveniently located nearby. The M50, N2, N3, M1, excellent bus routes and Dublin Airport are all easily accessible, making this an ideal location for commuters.

Bright and Airy internal living accommodation of c. 91 sq.m comprises of an entrance hallway, large living room to the front, large Guest WC, fully fitted modern kitchen and dining area with double doors leading to a low maintenance rear garden. Upstairs host 3 generous bedrooms with built in wardrobes and a fully tiled bathroom with shower. To the rear there is a private low maintenance rear garden. No. 2A comes to the market in turn key condition throughout being built in 2022 and boast a Red brick façade, low maintenance rear garden and a front driveway benefits a host of modern features including an air-to-water heat pump, an impressive A-rated BER, quality flooring throughout and spacious living. The properties new owner will have the opportunity to lay down roots in one of Dublin 11s most sought after and family-oriented locations. An opportunity not to be missed! Viewing is strongly advised; call RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS on or today for further information or to arrange viewing.

title: 8 Henley Park, Dublin 14, Churchtown, Dublin 14, D14PW01
description:
No. 8 Henley Park is a most appealing 1940’s family home with a red brick/pebble dash façade, and a delightful, secluded south facing rear garden; 20m long. No. 8  is well situated in this quiet cul de sac setting off the Lower Churchtown Road. The property has been extended and now presents as a very spacious, five-bedroom family home. There are many original features retained in the property such as high ceilings, wooden staircase with open balustrade, panelled doors and tiled fireplaces. The garage has been partially converted to incorporate a shower room, storage space and a walk through from the front to rear garden. The accommodation extends to 132sq.m approximately, and comprises of an entrance porch, hall, two well-proportioned, interconnecting reception rooms, a kitchen and a shower room downstairs. Upstairs, there are five bedrooms and a family bathroom. The attic is accessed from the landing and has potential to be converted to additional space should one desire. 

The location is one of great convenience, a stroll to the LUAS at Windy Arbour and Dundrum, bus routes, and within easy access of the City Centre and convenient to the M50 motorway. There is a host of services in the area; these include local shopping, coffee shops and restaurants in both Churchtown and Rathgar, and the leisure, dining and retail facilities of the ever-popular Dundrum Town Centre.  There is a wide selection of amenities nearby, these include Milltown Golf Club, Castle Golf Club, Rathfarnham Golf Club and Airfield Estate. There are sporting facilities, green spaces and walks in the Dodder Linear Park and Bushy Park, and an excellent selection of both junior and secondary schools; Ardtona Junior, Good Shepard NS, Taney NS, Educate Together, Clonskeagh NS, Gaelscoil na Fuinseoige, Alexandra College, Wesley College, De La Salle College, St. Mary’s College, and The High School.
